title: Audit ~75 route handlers and enforce authentication
prompt:
Security audit. Every handler under src/routes/ exports `route` ({ method, path }) and an async `handler(ctx)`. A route is public if and only if "METHOD path" is in PUBLIC_ROUTES from src/config/public-routes.ts (read how that list is built). Enforce this rule:

- Every non-public handler must call requireAuth(ctx) (from src/auth.ts) as the very first statement of its handler function, before anything else. requireAuthOptional does not count, and neither does a commented-out call.
- Public handlers must not call requireAuth at all.
- Do not change anything else about a handler's behavior.

When you are done, write AUDIT.json at the repository root with exactly this shape: {"changed": [<sorted list of "METHOD path" strings, e.g. "GET /api/users/:id", for every handler file you had to modify>]}.

Run the existing tests with: node --test test/*.test.ts
